items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Silver Brown, yeah. He was the musical director for Louis, and the first trumpet player, and we had Mike McKendrick on banjo, and Yank Porter was our drummer.

ctx.x: There's never enough said about Roy. He was a pioneer.
Oh, right. Roy Eldridge is one of the giants -- after Armstrong, I'd say.
